name: D2X-Rebirth
description:
D2X-Rebirth is an open-source source port of Descent II, the acclaimed six-degrees-of-freedom sci-fi shooter. Continuing the work of the DXX-Rebirth project, it brings Descent II natively to modern Linux desktops with enhanced visual clarity.

Features:
- True six-degrees-of-freedom space combat with improved physics precision
- High-resolution widescreen rendering with dynamic lighting and colored effects
- Support for modern joysticks, throttle controllers, gamepads, and mice
- High-fidelity digital music and sound effects playback using modern audio backends
- Complete compatibility with official missions, custom levels, and multiplayer modes
